description: The OnePlus Nord 6 feels like a stellar return to what made the Nord lineup relevant in the first place, capturing that elusive value-driven DNA. By borrowing heavily from flagship design elements and pairing them with a high-quality display and dependable performance, the handset stands out without cutting corners on core specifications. In a landscape where competitors are dialling back core hardware, the Nord 6 makes a persuasive case as a performance-focused disruptor in its segment.
title: OnePlus Nord 6 Review: Finally, a Mid-Ranger Without Compromise

description: A Cygnus XL launched aboard a Falcon 9 is delivering supplies and experiments to the International Space Station, supporting research in microgravity, medicine, and space weather.
title: SpaceX Falcon 9 Launches Cygnus XL for NASA ISS Resupply Mission

A senior Honor executive hinted at the debut, while Honor showcased the design through a promotional banner. description: Lumio Vision 9 (2026) has been teased ahead of its India launch, with an Amazon microsite going live, indicating an imminent debut. The upcoming model is expected to bring improvements in performance and viewing experience over the Vision 9 (2025). The current version, priced at Rs. 59,999, features a 55-inch 4K Mini-LED display with Quantum Dot, Dolby Vision support, and a BOSS processor. It also offers Google TV, a 24W speaker system, multiple connectivity options, and a slim design.
title: Lumio Vision 9 (2026) India Launch Teased, Amazon Availability Confirmed

The findings are important at a time when artificial intelligence (AI) companies based out of these two countries have started gaining a user base from across the globe.
title: Europeans Do Not Trust China, US Tech Companies With Their Data: Survey

description: Bob World Lite app, a new digital banking platform, has been launched in India by Bank of Baroda in partnership with Jio, the two entities announced on Monday. The new "Lite" version of the mobile app provides UPI-enabled “Scan & Pay”, transfer money, pay and manage bills, pay for prepaid recharge packs, and manage profiles functionalities. The app is specifically designed for feature phones. It will be first available on the JioPhone Prima 4G series handsets. Existing customers can get the app via JioStore. However, the future phones will ship with the app pre-installed.
title: Bob World Lite App Launched in India to Bring Digital Banking to Jio Feature Phones

description: Vivo introduced the X Fold 5 in July last year in India, and the brand now appears to be preparing its successor. The Vivo X Fold 6 is said to come with battery and camera upgrades over the existing model. It could get a 7,000mAh battery, and this will likely position the Vivo X Fold 6 as the foldable with the highest battery. The Vivo X Fold 5 has a 6,000mAh battery. The upcoming phone could feature a 200-megapixel rear camera unit.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Specifications Leak Hints at Major Battery and Camera Upgrades On the Way

description: Xiaomi is said to be developing HyperOS 4 as its iteration of the upcoming Android 17 operating system (OS). Early leaks around the OS have now started surfacing online. According to a tipster, HyperOS 4 could bring noticeable visual changes, in addition to deeper system-level improvements. The update is tipped to introduce a refreshed design language across the user interface (UI), with the brand also developing a Leica colour palette that may be incorporated in certain models.
title: Xiaomi's HyperOS 4 Update Said to Be in Development With ‘Significant Changes’, Leica-Inspired Colour Palette

title: Anju Sundarikal Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Malayalam Show Online

description: Laser printers from HP, Canon, and Brother under Rs. 25,000 deliver fast speeds, sharp text, and lower running costs. You can choose between print-only models or all-in-one options that handle scanning and copying. Most of these printers run at up to 30 pages per minute, support automatic duplex printing, and offer wireless features. Models like the HP Laser 303 series, Canon MF3010, HP MFP 323dnw, and Brother DCP-L2541DW work well for both home and small office use, offering a good mix of performance, features, and value.
title: Best Laser Printers Under Rs 25,000 in India

description: Xiaomi TV S Mini LED (2026) smart TV series will be launched in India on April 15, the tech giant announced on Monday. The new lineup will be offered in three sizes: 55-inch, 65-inch, and 75-inch. The phone will feature an AMOLED display with 1.5K resolution, 144Hz refresh rate and 5000 nits peak brightness. It will have a dual rear camera unit including a 50-megapixel primary Sony sensor and a 2-megapixel bokeh camera. For selfies and video chat, there is a 32-megapixel front camera.
title: Vivo T5 Pro 5G Confirmed to Feature 144Hz AMOLED Display, Dual Rear Cameras and IP69 Rating

It builds upon the design language of the Find X9 Pro, with a rear panel that prominently features a circular rear camera island. The brand has also announced a limited edition variant of the upcoming handset, which will bundle several camera-centric accessories.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Design, Colour Options Revealed Ahead of Launch; Hasselblad Earth Explorer Master Set Announced

The teased design and colour options of the upcoming handset are identical to the ones spotted in the leaked marketing material of the purported Motorola Edge 70 Pro. Moreover, the handset is teased to go on sale in three colour options, featuring tailored-fabric finish, satin-luxe finish, and marble finish.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro India Launch Inches Closer as Teasers for New Handset Surface on Flipkart

description: Redmi K90 Max will be launched on April 21. The launch event will begin at 7:00pm (4:30pm IST). The upcoming gaming-focused device will have a dual-core air cooling system for thermal management. It is confirmed to feature a 6.83-inch M10 display with a 165Hz refresh rate and 3500nits peak brightness. The Redmi K90 Max is rumoured to run on a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset.
title: Redmi K90 Max Launch Date Confirmed as Company Reveals Display Specifications

description: Huawei Pura X Max is set to launch in China on April 20 alongside the Pura 90 Pro series, with pre-orders already open. The foldable is listed in multiple configurations and colour options. The company has revealed its design, highlighting a wider form factor than typical foldables. The device is expected to offer a tablet-like experience when unfolded, with a large inner display and a smaller cover screen. It may feature a triple rear camera setup and could use the Kirin 9030 chipset.
title: Huawei Pura X Max Wide Set to Beat Apple, Samsung as Company Teases Wide Foldable Phone

title: Fable Could Reportedly Be Delayed to Later This Year to Avoid Clashing With GTA 6 Release

description: The Redmi A7 Pro 5G was launched in India on Monday. It arrives two weeks after its debut in select global markets. The handset sports a 6.9-inch HD+ LCD screen with 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by an octa-core Unisoc chipset, coupled with 4GB of RAM. The handset runs on Android 16-based HyperOS 3. The Redmi A7 Pro 5G has a 32-megapixel dual rear camera unit. It packs a 6,300mAh battery with 15W wired fast charging.
title: Redmi A7 Pro 5G Launched in India With 32-Megapixel Rear Camera, Unisoc T8300 SoC: Price, Specifications

The hackers have reportedly threated the GTA 6 developer with a leak unless it pays a ransom. In 2022, Rockstar Games suffered a massive hack that leaked gameplay footage from Grand Theft Auto 6.
title: GTA 6 Developer Rockstar Games Confirms Data Breach, Hackers Threaten With Leak

description: Bitcoin is trading in a narrow range near $71,000 as investors weigh geopolitical tensions and macroeconomic signals. While institutional inflows have improved, they remain inconsistent, limiting breakout potential. Altcoins are showing mixed performance, reflecting cautious sentiment across the broader market.
title: Bitcoin Price Approaches $71,000 Mark as Crypto Market Awaits Breakout Momentum

description: Oppo's Reno 16 series is tipped to include the standard Reno 16,  Reno 16 Pro,  Reno 16 Pro Mini and  Reno 16C models. They are said to come with the Plus Key feature, similar to the OnePlus 15. This button can be used to access AI features and launch apps. It can be used to select sound profiles and for camera controls. The feature debuted with the OnePlus 13s. The OnePlus 15s is tipped to launch in India toward the end of the second quarter or sometime in the third quarter.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Series Early Leak Hints at OnePlus 15-Inspired Feature; OnePlus 15s India Launch Timeline Tipped

description: Vivo X300 FE is expected to launch in India soon after its Russia debut, with reports suggesting support for a ZEISS Telephoto Extender Kit that could enable up to 200mm optical zoom and 1600mm focal length. The phone may feature a 50-megapixel telephoto camera, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, and OriginOS. It is tipped to offer multiple AI camera features, a 6,500mAh battery with fast charging, and a slim design. Pricing is expected to be lower than the Vivo X300.

The tablet is expected to feature a 13.2-inch LCD screen, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, and Android 16. It may come in multiple RAM and storage variants and include a 13-megapixel rear camera. description: Apple is testing four different styles of frames for its rumoured smart glasses, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman claims in the latest edition of his ‘Power On’ newsletter. Citing Apple employees working as part of the project, the Cupertino-based tech giant is reportedly exploring multiple frame styles, including a large rectangular frame, a slimmer rectangular frame, larger oval or circular frames, and a smaller, “more refined oval or circular option”. The company is also said to be testing multiple colour options for its smart glasses.
title: Apple Reportedly Testing Four Distinct Frame Styles, Designs for Its Smart Glasses

description: The UI for Android's upcoming Tap to Share UI feature has been spotted online. The functionality will enable the instant transfer of data between Android smartphones. Android requires the top portions of both phones to overlap to enable the transfer. Users should be able to see both screens during the process and have to keep the handsets together until a 'glow animation confirms the connection.
title: Android’s Tap to Share UI Spotted in New Leak That Reveals How NFC-Based File Sharing Will Work

description: Motorola is said to be gearing up to launch its next-generation foldable lineup, comprising the Razr 70 and Razr 70 Ultra. While the company has yet to confirm the details, the Ultra model has been spotted on a certification website in China. It hints towards its imminent launch in the region. The listing suggests that the Motorola Razr 70 Ultra may support similar wired charging speeds to its predecessor, the Razr 60 Ultra.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Ultra Bags 3C Certification Ahead of Launch, Charging Specifications Revealed

description: Oppo Find X9s Pro has been listed on the China Telecom website, revealing various details about the upcoming smartphone, including its battery capacity and camera configuration. The handset will be equipped with a 7,025mAh battery. The company recently confirmed that it will carry two Hasselblad-tuned 200-megapixel cameras on the back with Oppo’s LUMO imaging. However, the new China Telecom listing reveals that the Oppo Find X9s Pro will also be equipped with a 50-megapixel shooter, paired with a 3.2-megapixel sensor on the back.
title: Oppo Find X9s Pro Key Specifications, Features Listed on China Telecom Site Along With Storage Configurations

description: Infinix Note 60 Pro has been launched in India as the latest addition to the company’s Note series. The handset is set to go on sale in the country via the company’s online store and Flipkart. It is offered in three colour options, dubbed Deep Ocean Blue, Mocha Brown, and Solar Orange. Moreover, the handset is available for pre-order in India in 8GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The new Infinix smartphone is powered by an octa core Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset from Qualcomm, coupled with a 6,500mAh battery.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Launched in India With an Active Matrix Rear Display, 6,500mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung is said to have quietly revised the pricing of its flagship foldable, the Galaxy Z Fold 7, in the US. The handset, which was launched in July 2025, is expected to be superseded by its successor. Consumers typically expect older models to receive price cuts ahead of the launch of a successor. Instead, select variants of the company’s existing foldable have become more expensive, with the South Korean tech conglomerate taking a different approach this time.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 Price Increased in the US for Select Variants Ahead of Successor Launch

description: Apple’s first-ever foldable iPhone, ubiquitously known as the iPhone Fold, is widely rumoured to launch in 2026. In recent weeks, the rumour mill has suggested that the Cupertino-based tech giant is facing engineering challenges that could push the availability of the foldable handset into 2027. A seasoned journalist, however, has clarified that Apple’s plans for the iPhone Fold remain on schedule, with launch expected alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models later this year.
